translationRepairs: When Fan Yanguang rebelled from Ye, most neighboring districts were forced to join him, but Jing alone held his ground with divided forces. The Jin emperor commended him and appointed him military commissioner of Yaozhou.

When Fan Yanguang rebelled from Ye, most neighboring districts were forced to join him, but Jing alone held his ground with divided forces. The Jin emperor commended him and appointed him training commissioner of Yaozhou.
耀州團練使 is a training commissioner, not a military governor (節度使).
At the change of dynasty, while the Jin emperor was at Ye, Jing was left in charge as metropolitan patrol commissioner, then reassigned as military commissioner of Mingzhou.
When he was to be replaced, as the Jin emperor was visiting Ye, Jing was left as metropolitan patrol commissioner and then made training commissioner of Mingzhou.
及代 means when he was replaced in office, not a change of dynasty, and 洺州團練使 is a training commissioner.
Early in Xiande he was enfeoffed as Duke of Bao and given Ministerial rank.
Early in Xiande he was enfeoffed as Duke of Bao and given the Kaifu prestige rank.
開府階 is the Kaifu prestige rank (開府儀同三司), not a ministerial office.

Tingyi entered service as a palace attendant, then became deputy commissioner for the capital. His horsemanship won him promotion under Zhou Shizong to commandant of the Tiger Swift Guard, then colonel of the second right Dragon Swift army while holding Zhenzhou.

Tingyi entered service as a palace attendant, then became deputy Rujing commissioner. His horsemanship won him promotion under Zhou Shizong to commandant of the Tiger Swift Guard, then colonel of the second right Dragon Swift army while holding Zhenzhou.
如京副使 is deputy commissioner of the Rujing office, a capital-granary commissionership, not a deputy over the capital.

The Han emperor had taken the throne but his name still rang small. Yan's defection delighted him. That same day he made Hui governor of Baoping, Zhang of Zhenguo, and Yan defender of Jiangzhou while keeping their old posts.

The Han emperor had taken the throne but his name still rang small. Yan's defection delighted him. That same day he made Hui military governor of Baoping and Zhang military governor of Zhenguo, and Yan defender of Jiangzhou while keeping their old posts.
保平軍節度 and 鎮國軍節度 are military governorships.
When the Zhou founder acceded, Yan was made concurrent Palace Attendant.
When the Zhou founder acceded, Yan was made concurrent Director of the Chancellery.
侍中 is Director of the Chancellery, not a palace attendant.
After the suburban sacrifice he was enfeoffed as Duke of Teng and given Ministerial rank.
After the suburban sacrifice he was enfeoffed as Duke of Teng and given the Kaifu prestige rank.
開府階 is the Kaifu prestige rank, not a ministerial office.
Shizong had Zhang Zheng compose the inscription, renamed his home village Xunde Lane in Ministers' Township, and ordered halberds set before his gate.

Shizong had Zhang Zheng, Director of the Bureau of Review and Drafter of Edicts, compose the inscription, renamed his home village Xunde Lane in Ministers' Township, and ordered halberds set before his gate.
比部郎中、知制誥 is Director of the Bureau of Review and Drafter of Edicts; the draft omitted the office.
After an offense he was sent out as deputy military commissioner of Suzhou.
After an offense he was sent out as deputy training commissioner of Suzhou.
團練副使 is a deputy training commissioner, not a military governor.
Early in Zhou Guangshun he was made Palace Attendant as well and transferred to Xuzhou.
Early in Zhou Guangshun he was made Director of the Chancellery as well and transferred to Xuzhou.
侍中 is Director of the Chancellery, not a palace attendant.
Early in Xiande, at the suburban sacrifice, he was made Inspector Grand Preceptor.
Early in Xiande, at the suburban sacrifice, he was made honorary Grand Preceptor.
檢校太師 is an honorary Grand Preceptor, not an inspector (監察).

When Shizong prepared to campaign against Liu Chong, Congyi happened to be at court and asked to join him. Shizong was delighted, made him governor of Tianping, and sent him with Fu Yanqing to defeat the Khitan at Xinkou.

When Shizong prepared to campaign against Liu Chong, Congyi happened to be at court and asked to join him. Shizong was delighted, made him military governor of Tianping, and sent him with Fu Yanqing to defeat the Khitan at Xinkou.
天平軍節度 is a military governorship.
When Shizong reached Sizhou after escorting the imperial carriage, Congyi was received at the field headquarters.
When Shizong came from Yingluan to Sizhou, Congyi was received at the field headquarters.
迎鑾 is the place Yingluan, not the act of escorting the imperial carriage.
When Emperor Gong succeeded, Congyi was granted the privilege of an independent staff.
When Emperor Gongdi acceded, Congyi was given the Kaifu prestige rank.
恭帝 is Emperor Gongdi, and 開府階 is the Kaifu prestige rank.
In the second Kaibao year he was made Grand General of the Left Golden Crow Guard.
In the second Kaibao year he was made Grand General of the Left Imperial Insignia Guard.
金吾衛 is the Imperial Insignia Guard, not a golden crow.
